title: Funerary Stele of Aurelia Artemis
image_changes: None; museum JPEG reproduced unchanged. The Walters Art Museum, CC0.
text_changes: Museum inscription field separated into translation, transcription and alternative rendering; wording preserved, HTML whitespace normalized. Longer description excluded.

passages.text: Farewell Aurelia Artemis, Pasion’s daughter, incomparably sweetest among all.
passages.source_text: Αὐρηλίαν Ἄρτεμειν θυγατέρα Πασίωνος τὴν γλυκυτάτην ἀσύνκριτον ἐν πᾶσι· εὐψύχι

note: The museum supplies the Greek epitaph and its corresponding English rendering; the photograph shows the four-line epitaph below the figure. Egyptian geography, Greek language; no separate Mediterranean count. AncientLens scholarly review: unreviewed. Egypt, Akhmim (Place of Discovery). Ownership history: Dikran Kelekian, New York and Paris, by purchase; Henry Walters, Baltimore, 1923, by purchase; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
